title: Cross-stitch 'This is my happy place' quote
subtitle: A short phrase in mixed upper and lower case with a small floral motif
excerpt: A short two-line quote, 'This is my happy place', in a clean mixed-case script alphabet with a small cluster of flowers beneath the text on 14-count cream Aida. The design is approximately 90 by 70 stitches and finishes at around 16 by 12 cm. The phrase suits a kitchen, craft room, or study wall.
sourceNotes: Original design. The phrase 'happy place' is in common use and not copyright. The mixed-case alphabet format is a modern variant of the traditional sampler alphabet style.

content.text: Script-style cross-stitch alphabets look like handwriting but are worked from a pixel grid like any other cross-stitch chart. Each letter is a distinct pattern; spacing between letters is set by the chart. The flower cluster below the text is optional but helps fill the lower half of the composition.

items.label: Thread
items.value: DMC 3750 (very dark antique blue) — for main text, 3721 (dark shell pink), 3722 (medium shell pink), 320 (medium pistachio), 368 (light pistachio) — for the flower cluster

content.text: Count the total stitch width of 'This is my' and 'happy place' separately. Both lines should centre on the same vertical axis. Start from the fabric centre and count left to the starting stitch of each line before stitching.
Stitch 'This is my' on the first text row.
Work each letter in cross-stitch fill from the chart. Leave two stitch widths between letters and four between words.
Stitch 'happy place' on the second row.
Leave three to four rows of Aida blank between the two text lines for visual breathing room.
Add the flower cluster below the text.
Work three small pink flowers in 3721 and 3722 with paired leaf sets in 320 and 368. Position the cluster centrally below 'happy place'.
Frame in a 20 × 16 cm mount or display in a 20 cm oval hoop. The cream Aida background works without any added border stitching.
